sentences.en: The parking spaces nearest the door are reserved for executives.
sentences.zh: 紧挨着门口的停车位是为高管预留的。

sentences.en: The executive committee appointed him the president of the company.
sentences.zh: 执行委员会任命他为公司的总裁。

sentences.en: Senior executives spend a lot of time training their subordinates.
sentences.zh: 高层管理人员花大量时间培训下属。
